title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
statement: Swap every two adjacent nodes of a linked list and return the new head. Change the links, not the values. A leftover last node stays where it is.
reference_solution:
def swapPairs(head):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    while prev.next and prev.next.next:
        a = prev.next
        b = a.next
        a.next = b.next
        b.next = a
        prev.next = b
        prev = a
    return dummy.next

hints.1_question: After swapping a pair, the node before it must point to the new first node of the pair. What helps you keep track of that previous node?
hints.2_nudge: Use a dummy head. For prev, take a = prev.next and b = a.next; rewire prev -> b -> a -> (rest), then move prev to a.
hints.3_big_hint: a.next = b.next; b.next = a; prev.next = b; prev = a. Loop while prev.next and prev.next.next.

known_bugs.name: drops the unpaired last node
known_bugs.code:
def swapPairs(head):
    dummy = ListNode(0)
    tail = dummy
    while head and head.next:
        a = head
        b = head.next
        head = b.next
        b.next = a
        a.next = None
        tail.next = b
        tail = a
    return dummy.next
known_bugs.followup: For [1, 2, 3], where does the 3 go in your result?

known_bugs.name: forgets to link the previous pair to the swapped pair
known_bugs.code:
def swapPairs(head):
    if not head or not head.next:
        return head
    new_head = head.next
    prev = None
    cur = head
    while cur and cur.next:
        a = cur
        b = cur.next
        nxt = b.next
        b.next = a
        a.next = nxt
        cur = nxt
    return new_head
known_bugs.followup: After you swap (1,2) the node 1 should point to the next pair's NEW first node (4), not to 3. Where is that link set?

known_bugs.name: recursive version (recursion limit)
known_bugs.code:
def swapPairs(head):
    if not head or not head.next:
        return head
    second = head.next
    head.next = swapPairs(second.next)
    second.next = head
    return second
known_bugs.followup: How deep does the recursion get on 100000 nodes?
